1131: ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥੨॥
Through the Name, glory is obtained in the Name, by one in whose mind He enshrines it. ॥2॥
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਤਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ; ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
Meeting the True Guru, one obtains the fruit; true living is the essence of peace.
ਸੇ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ. ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਗੇ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਧਰਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੩॥
Pure are those who are attached to the Lord and enshrine love for the Lord's Name. ॥3॥
ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਮਿਲੈ. ਤਾਂ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਾਈ; ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
If I obtain the dust of those who have meditated on the perfect True Guru, I apply it to my forehead.
ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ. ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਪਾਈਐ; ਜਿਨੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੩॥
Nanak, the dust of those who have focused their awareness on the Lord's Name is obtained by perfect destiny. ॥4॥3॥13॥
ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ. ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ; ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
One who reflects on the Word is true — those in whose hearts the True One dwells.
ਸਾਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ. ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਤਾਂ ਤਨਿ ਦੂਖੁ. ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
They perform true devotion day and night, and then no pain afflicts the body. ॥1॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ. ਭਗਤਿ, ਨ ਪਾਈਐ; ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Without serving the True Guru, devotion is not obtained; by perfect destiny that God is met. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੂਲੁ ਗਵਾਵਹਿ. ਲਾਭੁ ਮਾਗਹਿ; ਲਾਹਾ ਲਾਭੁ. ਕਿਦੂ ਹੋਈ ॥
The self-willed lose their capital yet ask for profit; how can they earn any gain?
ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ; ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥੨॥
The Messenger of Death ever hangs over their heads; in love of duality they lose their honour. ॥2॥
ਬਹਲੇ ਭੇਖ ਭਵਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Wearing many religious garbs, they wander day and night, but the disease of ego does not go.
ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਲੂਝਹਿ. ਬਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ; ਮਿਲਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੩॥
Reading and reading, they quarrel and argue; meeting Maya, they lose their awareness. ॥3॥
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ. ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ; ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Those who serve the True Guru attain the supreme state; through the Name they obtain glory.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਨਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ; ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੪॥
Nanak, those in whose minds the Name dwells obtain honour at the True Door. ॥4॥4॥14॥
ਮਨਮੁਖ ਆਸਾ. ਨਹੀ ਉਤਰੈ; ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਏ ॥
The hope of the self-willed never leaves; they are ruined by love of duality.
ਉਦਰੁ ਨੈ ਸਾਣੁ. ਨ ਭਰੀਐ ਕਬਹੂ; ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਪਚਾਏ ॥੧॥
Their belly, like a river, is never filled; the fire of craving consumes them. ॥1॥
Those imbued with the Lord's essence are ever in bliss.
ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ. ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਗੀ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
With the Name in their hearts, duality has fled their minds; drinking the nectar of the Lord, Har Har, they are satisfied. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਆਪੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ. ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਜੀ; ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਏ ॥
The transcendent Lord Himself, who fashioned the creation, attaches each and every one to their tasks.
ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਕੀਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪੇ; ਆਪੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਏ ॥੨॥
He Himself created attachment to Maya, and He Himself attaches beings to duality. ॥2॥
ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਹੁ ਕਹੀਐ. ਜੇ ਦੂਜਾ ਹੋਵੈ; ਸਭਿ ਤੁਧੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
We could say something to Him if there were another; all are absorbed in You.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ; ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੩॥
The Guru-facing reflect on the essence of wisdom, and their light merges in the Light. ॥3॥
ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ. ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਾਚਾ; ਸਾਚਾ ਸਭੁ ਆਕਾਰਾ ॥
That God is true, forever true; true is all His creation.
ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ; ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੫॥
Nanak, the True Guru has given understanding; through the True Name one is saved. ॥4॥5॥15॥
ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਤ. ਜਿਨੑੀ ਰਾਮੁ. ਨ ਪਛਾਤਾ; ਸਤਜੁਗਿ ਪਰਮ ਹੰਸ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
In the Dark Age, those who have not recognised the Lord are ghosts; in the Golden Age, the supreme swans were those who reflected.
ਦੁਆਪੁਰਿ ਤ੍ਰੇਤੈ ਮਾਣਸ ਵਰਤਹਿ; ਵਿਰਲੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
In the Dwapar and Treta ages there were people too; rare was the one who subdued ego. ॥1॥
In the Dark Age, glory is in the Lord's Name.
ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ; ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਮੁਕਤਿ, ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
In every age the Guru-facing have known the One; without the Name, liberation is not obtained. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਖੈ. ਜਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
One who perceives the Name in the heart is a true servant; as Guru-facing he enshrines it in the mind.
ਆਪਿ ਤਰੇ. ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੇ; ਜਿਨੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੨॥
Those who are lovingly attuned to the Lord's Name save themselves and save all their generations. ॥2॥
ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਣ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ; ਅਵਗਣ. ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
My God is the Giver of virtue; through the Word He burns away faults.
1132: ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ. ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸੋਹੇ; ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਏ ॥੩॥
Those in whose minds He dwells are beautified; they enshrine the Name in their hearts. ॥3॥
ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਮਹਲੁ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ; ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਰਲੀਆ ਮਾਣੈ ॥
The True Guru has shown one the Lord's home, door and mansion; one enjoys the pleasure of His love.
ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹੈ. ਸੁ ਭਲਾ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੈ; ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੬॥
Whatever He says, one accepts as good; Nanak, one repeats the Name. ॥4॥6॥16॥
ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ਲੈ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰ ॥
Merge the mind's desires into the mind, reflecting through the Guru's Word.
ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਵੈ; ਫਿਰਿ ਮਰੈ ਨ. ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
From the perfect Guru understanding comes, and one does not die again and again. ॥1॥
O my mind, the Lord's Name is your support.
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸਭ ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
By the Guru's grace one attains the supreme state; the Lord fulfils every desire. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ; ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ. ਬੂਝ, ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
The One pervades all, but without the Guru this is not understood.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਆ. ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ; ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੨॥
To the Guru-facing my Lord God is revealed; night and day they sing the Lord's praises. ॥2॥
ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ; ਹੋਰ ਥੈ ਸੁਖੁ. ਨ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
The Lord alone is the Giver of peace; peace is not found anywhere else.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨੀ. ਨ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਦਾਤਾ; ਸੇ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਏ ਪਛੁਤਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
Those who have not served the True Guru, the Giver, depart repenting in the end. ॥3॥
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਫਿਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ. ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਧਾਇ ॥
Serving the True Guru, one finds everlasting peace, and pain does not rush in again.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ; ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੭॥
Nanak, one obtains devotion to the Lord, and one's light merges in the Light. ॥4॥7॥17॥
ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ. ਜਗਤੁ ਬਉਰਾਨਾ; ਭੂਲਾ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਈ ॥
Without the Guru the world has gone mad; misled, it suffers blows.
ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ. ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ; ਦਰ ਕੀ ਖਬਰਿ. ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
It dies and is reborn again and again, ever suffering pain, and knows nothing of the Lord's door. ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ; ਸਦਾ ਰਹਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾ ॥
O my mind, remain ever in the sanctuary of the True Guru.
ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਸਦ ਲਾਗਾ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੇ. ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The Lord's Name ever seems sweet in the heart; through the Guru's Word the terrifying ocean is crossed. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਭੇਖ ਕਰੈ. ਬਹੁਤੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਡੋਲੈ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
He wears religious garbs, but his mind wavers greatly; within are lust, anger and ego.
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤਿਸਾ ਭੂਖ, ਅਤਿ ਬਹੁਤੀ; ਭਉਕਤ ਫਿਰੈ ਦਰ ਬਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Within is great thirst and hunger; he wanders barking from door to door. ॥2॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰਹਿ. ਫਿਰਿ ਜੀਵਹਿ; ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰਿ ॥
Those who die in the Guru's Word and live again find the door of liberation.
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ; ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
Within them is tranquillity and everlasting peace; they keep the Lord enshrined in their hearts. ॥3॥
ਜਿਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ. ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਵੈ; ਕਰਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
As it pleases Him, so He makes us walk; nothing can be done.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੪॥੮॥੧੮॥
Nanak, the Guru-facing cherish the Word; glory is in the Lord's Name. ॥4॥8॥18॥
ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਖੁਆਇਆ; ਦੁਖੁ ਖਟੇ. ਦੁਖ ਖਾਇ ॥
Ruined by ego and attachment to Maya, he earns pain and eats pain.
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭ ਹਲਕੁ. ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਰੀ; ਬਿਨੁ ਬਿਬੇਕ. ਭਰਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
Within him is the madness of greed, a heavy pain; without discernment he wanders lost. ॥1॥
Cursed is the life of the self-willed in the world.
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਪਨੈ. ਨਹੀ ਚੇਤਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ. ਕਦੇ, ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
He does not remember the Lord's Name even in dreams; he never comes to love the Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਪਸੂਆ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੈ. ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝੈ; ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਕੂੜੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
He acts like a beast and does not understand; practising falsehood, he becomes false.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ. ਤ ਉਲਟੀ ਹੋਵੈ; ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
If he meets the True Guru he is turned around; a rare servant searches and finds the Lord. ॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ. ਰਿਦੈ ਸਦ ਵਸਿਆ; ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
One in whose heart the Name of the Lord, Har Har, ever dwells has found the treasure of virtue.
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ; ਚੂਕਾ ਮਨ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
By the Guru's grace he has found the Perfect One; the pride of his mind is gone. ॥3॥
ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ; ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
The Creator Himself acts and causes others to act; He Himself sets them on the path.
1133: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੪॥੯॥੧੯॥
He Himself grants glory to the Guru-facing; Nanak, they merge in the Name. ॥4॥9॥19॥
ਮੇਰੀ ਪਟੀਆ ਲਿਖਹੁ; ਹਰਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥
"Write on my tablet the Name of the Lord, Govind, Gopal."
Those in love with duality are caught in Death's net.
The True Guru cherishes and protects me;
the Lord, the Giver of peace, is with me. ॥1॥
Following the Guru's teaching, Prahlad chants the Lord's Name;
ਸਾਸਨਾ ਤੇ ਬਾਲਕੁ; ਗਮੁ. ਨ ਕਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
the child is not afraid of punishment. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
His mother counsels him: "O my beloved Prahlad,
ਪੁਤ੍ਰ. ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਛੋਡਹੁ; ਜੀਉ ਲੇਹੁ ਉਬਾਰੇ ॥
my son, give up the Lord's Name and save your life."
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ. ਨ ਛੋਡਾ; ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥੨॥
I will not give up the Lord's Name; the Guru has made me understand it." ॥2॥
Sanda and Marka went and complained to the king:
ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦੁ ਆਪਿ ਵਿਗੜਿਆ; ਸਭਿ ਚਾਟੜੇ ਵਿਗਾੜੇ ॥
"Prahlad has gone astray himself and led all the pupils astray."
In the court of the wicked a plot was hatched,
but the Lord became Prahlad's protector. ॥3॥
ਹਾਥਿ ਖੜਗੁ ਕਰਿ ਧਾਇਆ; ਅਤਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ॥
Sword in hand, the king rushed at him in great arrogance:
ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਹਾ; ਤੁਝੁ ਲਏ ਉਬਾਰਿ ॥
"Where is your Lord, who will save you?"
ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਭੈਆਨ ਰੂਪੁ; ਨਿਕਸਿਆ ਥੰਮੑ ਉਪਾੜਿ ॥
In an instant the Lord appeared in a dreadful form, bursting out of the pillar.
ਹਰਣਾਖਸੁ ਨਖੀ ਬਿਦਾਰਿਆ; ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦੁ ਲੀਆ ਉਬਾਰਿ ॥੪॥
He tore Harnakhash apart with His claws and saved Prahlad. ॥4॥
ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੇ; ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
The dear Lord resolves the affairs of the saints.
ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦ ਜਨ ਕੇ; ਇਕੀਹ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥
He saved twenty-one generations of His servant Prahlad.
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਰੇ ॥
Through the Guru's Word, the poison of ego is destroyed;
Nanak, through the Lord's Name the saints are saved. ॥5॥10॥20॥
ਆਪੇ ਦੈਤ ਲਾਇ ਦਿਤੇ, ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ; ਆਪੇ ਰਾਖਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
He Himself set the demons on His saints, and He Himself is their protector.
ਜੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਰਣਾਈ; ਤਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਦੁਖੁ. ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
Those who remain ever in Your sanctuary — no pain touches their minds. ॥1॥
ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ; ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਰਖਦਾ ਆਇਆ ॥
In every age He has protected His devotees.
ਦੈਤ ਪੁਤ੍ਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦੁ. ਗਾਇਤ੍ਰੀ ਤਰਪਣੁ ਕਿਛੂ, ਨ ਜਾਣੈ; ਸਬਦੇ, ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Prahlad, the demon's son, knew nothing of the Gayatri or ancestral offerings; through the Word he was united in union with the Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ; ਦੁਬਿਧਾ. ਸਬਦੇ ਖੋਈ ॥
Those who worship night and day, day and night, have rid themselves of duality through the Word.
ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੈ. ਜੋ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ; ਸਚੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਈ ॥੨॥
Ever pure are those imbued with the True One; the True One dwells in their minds. ॥2॥
ਮੂਰਖ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਪੜ੍ਹਹਿ. ਮੂਲੁ, ਨ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ; ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
The fools read of duality and do not recognise the Source; they waste their lives in vain.
ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਹਿ; ਦੁਸਟੁ ਦੈਤੁ ਚਿੜਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
They slander the saints, and they stirred up the wicked demon. ॥3॥
ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦੁ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ. ਨ ਪੜੈ, ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ, ਨ ਛੋਡੈ; ਡਰੈ ਨ. ਕਿਸੈ ਦਾ ਡਰਾਇਆ ॥
Prahlad does not read of duality and does not give up the Lord's Name; he is not frightened by anyone's threats.
ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਰਾਖਾ; ਦੈਤੈ ਕਾਲੁ ਨੇੜਾ ਆਇਆ ॥੪॥
The dear Lord is the protector of His saints; the demon's death drew near. ॥4॥
ਆਪਣੀ ਪੈਜ ਆਪੇ ਰਾਖੈ; ਭਗਤਾਂ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
He Himself preserves His own honour and grants glory to His devotees.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਣਾਖਸੁ ਨਖੀ ਬਿਦਾਰਿਆ; ਅੰਧੈ. ਦਰ ਕੀ ਖਬਰਿ, ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੫॥੧੧॥੨੧॥
Nanak, He tore Harnakhash apart with His claws; the blind demon knew nothing of the Lord's door. ॥5॥11॥21॥
Bhairo · Chaupade · Guru Ram Das · Ghar 1
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸੰਤ; ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ, ਪਗਿ ਲਾਇਣੁ ॥
In His mercy, the Lord attaches one to the feet of the saints, His servants.
1134: Through the Guru's Word, meditate on the Lord, absorbing your awareness in Him. ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ; ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਰਾਇਣੁ ॥
O my mind, meditate on the Name of the Lord, Narayan.
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਰਾਇਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
When the Lord, Har Har, the Giver of peace, shows mercy, the Guru-facing are carried across the terrifying ocean through the Lord's Name. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Joining the company of the holy, sing of the Lord;
through the Guru's teaching, take the Lord's elixir. ॥2॥
ਗੁਰ ਸਾਧੂ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਗਿਆਨ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਇਣੁ ॥
Bathe in the nectar pool of wisdom of the holy Guru,
and all sins and misdeeds are washed away. ॥3॥
You Yourself are the Creator, the support of the world.
ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੇਲਿ; ਤੇਰਾ ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਇਣੁ ॥੪॥੧॥
Unite servant Nanak with You; he is the slave of Your slaves. ॥4॥1॥
ਬੋਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਸਫਲ ਸਾ ਘਰੀ ॥
Utter the Lord's Name; fruitful is that hour.
Through the Guru's teaching, all pains are removed. ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ; ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਰਹਰੀ ॥
O my mind, meditate on the Name of the Lord.
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ; ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੰਗਿ. ਸਿੰਧੁ ਭਉ ਤਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
In Your mercy, unite me with the perfect Guru; in the true congregation I may cross the terrifying ocean. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Meditate on the Life of the world; remember the Lord in your mind.
He will remove your sins of millions upon millions of lives. ॥2॥
One whose face is touched by the dust of the holy in the true congregation
has bathed at the sixty-eight pilgrimage places and the Ganges. ॥3॥
ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਕਉ; ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੀ ॥
The Lord has shown mercy to me, a fool;
the Lord, the Saviour, has saved servant Nanak. ॥4॥2॥
Make good deeds your conduct and the Lord's essence your rosary;
turn it in your heart, and it will go along with you. ॥1॥
Chant the Name of the Lord, Har Har, the Lord of the forest.
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ; ਤੂਟਿ ਗਈ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਮ ਜਾਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
In Your mercy, unite me with the true congregation; then the net of Maya and Death is broken. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
One who as Guru-facing has laboured in service
has the Word fashioned in him in the true mint. ॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ; ਗੁਰਿ. ਅਗਮ ਦਿਖਾਲੀ ॥
The Lord is inaccessible and unfathomable; the Guru has shown me the Inaccessible One.
ਵਿਚਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰ; ਲਧਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਲੀ ॥੩॥
Searching within the town of the body, I found the Lord. ॥3॥
We are children; the Lord is our Father and Sustainer.
Save servant Nanak, blessing him with Your glance. ॥4॥3॥
ਸਭਿ ਘਟ ਤੇਰੇ; ਤੂ ਸਭਨਾ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
All hearts are Yours; You are in all.
There is no one outside of You. ॥1॥
The Lord is the Giver of peace; meditate on Him, O my mind.
ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ; ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਾਪੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I praise You; You are my Lord God, my Father. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ; ਤਹ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
Wherever I look, there is that Lord God.
ਸਭ ਤੇਰੈ ਵਸਿ; ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
All are under Your control; there is no other. ॥2॥
ਜਿਸ ਕਉ; ਤੁਮ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
One whom You wish to protect, O Lord —
ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਨੇੜੈ; ਕੋਇ. ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
no one can come near him. ॥3॥
ਤੂ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਸਭ ਤੈ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
You fully pervade water, land and sky, everywhere.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ; ਹਾਜਰਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥੪॥੪॥
Servant Nanak, meditate on the ever-present Lord. ॥4॥4॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸੰਤੁ. ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੂਰਤਿ; ਜਿਸੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥
The Lord's saint is the very image of the Lord, in whose heart is the Lord's Name.
ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ; ਸੋ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ. ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
One with such destiny written on the forehead cherishes the Lord's Name in the heart through the Guru's teaching. ॥1॥
1135: Meditate on the Lord, the slayer of demons, enshrining Him in your heart.
ਦੇਹੀ ਨਗਰਿ ਤਸਕਰ ਪੰਚ ਧਾਤੂ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਢੇ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
In the town of the body are five restless thieves; through the Guru's Word the Lord has beaten them and driven them out. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਿਨ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ; ਤਿਨ ਕਾਰਜ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
Those whose minds are pleased with the Lord — the Lord Himself resolves their affairs.
ਤਿਨ ਚੂਕੀ ਮੁਹਤਾਜੀ ਲੋਕਨ ਕੀ; ਹਰਿ ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
Their dependence on people is ended; the Lord, the Creator, has taken their side. ॥2॥
ਮਤਾ ਮਸੂਰਤਿ ਤਾਂ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਜੈ; ਜੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਵੈ. ਹਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ॥
We could make plans and take counsel only if anything were outside the Lord.
ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ. ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਹੋਸੀ; ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
Whatever He does will be for the good; meditate night and day on the Name of the Lord. ॥3॥
ਹਰਿ ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ. ਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ; ਓਹੁ. ਪੂਛਿ ਨ ਕਿਸੈ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Whatever the Lord does, He does by Himself alone; He does not consult anyone before acting.
ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ; ਜਿਨਿ ਮੇਲਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੧॥੫॥
Nanak, ever meditate on that God, who in His mercy has united us with the True Guru. ॥4॥1॥5॥
ਤੇ ਸਾਧੂ. ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਜਿਨ ਜਪਿਆ. ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
Unite me, O Lord, Master, with those holy ones, meditating on whom I may be saved.
ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਦਰਸੁ ਦੇਖਿ. ਮਨੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ; ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ. ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
Seeing their sight, my mind blossoms; each moment I am a sacrifice to them. ॥1॥
Meditate in your heart on the Name of the Lord.
ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਜਗਤ ਪਿਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਹਮ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸ ਕੀਜੈ ਪਨਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Show mercy, show mercy, O Father of the world, Master; make me the water-carrier of the slaves of Your slaves. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਤਿਨ ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ. ਤਿਨ ਪਤਿ ਊਤਮ; ਜਿਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਿਆ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥
Sublime is their understanding and sublime their honour, in whose hearts the Lord dwells.
ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਤਿਨ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
Attach me to their service, O Lord, Master; remembering them, I am saved. ॥2॥
ਜਿਨ. ਐਸਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਧੁ, ਨ ਪਾਇਆ; ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਕਾਢੇ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
Those who have not found such a holy True Guru are beaten and driven out of the Lord's court.
ਤੇ ਨਰ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਸੋਭ. ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ; ਤਿਨ ਨਕ ਕਾਟੇ. ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
Those slanderers obtain no glory; the Creator Himself has cut off their noses. ॥3॥
ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਲਾਵੈ. ਆਪੇ ਬੋਲੈ; ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਰਾਹਾਰੀ ॥
The Lord Himself makes us speak and Himself speaks; the Lord Himself is immaculate, formless, needing no sustenance.
ਹਰਿ. ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਮੇਲਹਿ, ਸੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਮਿਲਸੀ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਿਆ ਏਹਿ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੨॥੬॥
Lord, one whom You unite meets You; servant Nanak, what can these poor beings do? ॥4॥2॥6॥
ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ. ਸਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ; ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਨਣੇ ॥
That alone is Your true congregation, O Lord, where the Lord's praise is heard.
ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣਿਆ. ਮਨੁ ਭੀਨਾ; ਤਿਨ ਹਮ ਸ੍ਰੇਵਹ ਨਿਤ ਚਰਣੇ ॥੧॥
Those who have heard the Lord's Name and whose minds are drenched — I ever serve their feet. ॥1॥
Meditating on the Lord, the Life of the world, one crosses over.
ਅਨੇਕ ਅਸੰਖ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੇ; ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਇਤੁ ਗਨਣੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Countless, innumerable are Your Names, O Lord; this tongue cannot count them. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਹੁ. ਹਰਿ ਗਾਵਹੁ; ਲੇ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਣੇ ॥
O Sikhs of the Guru, utter the Lord, sing of the Lord; take the Guru's teaching and meditate on the Lord.
ਜੋ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਸੁਣੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੇਰਾ; ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ. ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖ ਘਣੇ ॥੨॥
One who listens to the Guru's teaching obtains abundant peace from the Lord. ॥2॥
ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਵੰਸੁ. ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਪਿਤਾ; ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਮਾਤਾ. ਜਿਨਿ ਜਨ ਜਣੇ ॥
Blessed is that lineage, blessed that father, blessed that mother who gave birth to such servants.
ਜਿਨ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ. ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ; ਸੇ ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ. ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਬਣੇ ॥੩॥
Those who have meditated on my Lord, Har Har, with every breath and morsel become the Lord's servants in the True Court. ॥3॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੇ; ਵਿਚਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਰਣੇ ॥
Your Names, O Lord, Har Har, are unfathomable; You have placed them within Your devotees.
ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ; ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਵਣੇ ॥੪॥੩॥੭॥
Servant Nanak has obtained understanding through the Guru's teaching; meditating on the Lord, Har Har, he crosses over. ॥4॥3॥7॥
1136: One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
Setting aside all the other lunar days,
you say the Lord of the universe was born on the eighth. ॥1॥
Deluded by doubt, mortal, you talk nonsense.
ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਤੇ ਰਹਤ; ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The Lord is beyond birth and death. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
You prepare sweets and feed them secretly to a stone image.
ਓਹੁ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਮਰੈ; ਰੇ ਸਾਕਤ ਢੋਰ ॥੨॥
He is neither born nor dies, you faithless fool. ॥2॥
You sing lullabies to a stone god — the root of all wrongdoing.
ਸੋ ਮੁਖੁ ਜਲਉ; ਜਿਤੁ ਕਹਹਿ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਜੋਨੀ ॥੩॥
Let that mouth burn which says the Master enters wombs. ॥3॥
ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਮਰੈ; ਨ ਆਵੈ. ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
He is not born, does not die, does not come or go.
At peace standing up, at peace sitting down,
ਭਉ ਨਹੀ ਲਾਗੈ; ਜਾਂ ਐਸੇ ਬੁਝੀਆ ॥੧॥
no fear touches one who understands this. ॥1॥
The one Master is my protector,
the Inner-knower of all hearts. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
I sleep without anxiety and wake without anxiety;
ਘਰਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸਿਆ; ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
I dwell in peace at home, and find peace outside too.
Says Nanak, the Guru has implanted this teaching within. ॥3॥2॥
ਵਰਤ. ਨ ਰਹਉ; ਨ ਮਹ ਰਮਦਾਨਾ ॥
I do not keep the fasts, nor the month of Ramadan.
I serve only Him who protects in the end. ॥1॥
The one Lord of the world, Allah, is mine;
I have settled accounts with both Hindu and Turk. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਜ ਕਾਬੈ ਜਾਉ ਨ ਤੀਰਥ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
I do not go on Hajj to the Kaaba, nor worship at pilgrimage places.
I serve the One alone, and no other. ॥2॥
I do not perform worship, nor offer namaz.
Taking the one Formless Lord into my heart, I bow to Him. ॥3॥
I am neither Hindu nor Muslim.
My body and breath belong to Allah, the Lord. ॥4॥
Says Kabir, this is what I declare:
ਗੁਰ ਪੀਰ ਮਿਲਿ; ਖੁਦਿ ਖਸਮੁ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥੫॥੩॥
meeting the Guru, the Pir, I have recognised my own Master. ॥5॥3॥
With poise I have caught and bound the ten does;
ਪਾਂਚ ਮਿਰਗ ਬੇਧੇ; ਸਿਵ ਕੀ ਬਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
I have shot the five deer with the unfailing Word. ॥1॥
Taking the saints with me, I went out hunting.
ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਪਕਰੇ; ਬਿਨੁ ਘੋਰ ਹਥੀਆਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I caught the deer without horses or weapons. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The urge to hunt outside has run off;
I found the prey in the village of my own home. ॥2॥
I caught the deer and brought them home to my shop;
ਚੁਖ ਚੁਖ ਲੇ ਗਏ; ਬਾਂਢੇ ਬਾਟਿ ॥੩॥
bit by bit, the saints carried them off to distant places. ॥3॥
This prey has been given to me as a gift;
in Nanak's home there is only the Name. ॥4॥4॥
Even if the faithless one is fed with longing a hundred times,
ਸਾਕਤ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚੀਤਿ. ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
the Lord, Har Har, does not come into his awareness. ॥1॥
Take the counsel of the saints.
In the company of the holy you will attain the supreme state. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Much water is poured over a stone,
but it does not get soaked; it stays completely dry. ॥2॥
1137: The six Shastras are recited to a fool,
but to him it is like the wind blowing in the ten directions. ॥3॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਕਣ. ਖਲਹਾਨੁ; ਜੈਸੇ ਗਾਹਨ. ਪਾਇਆ ॥
As threshing a heap without grain,
ਤਿਉ ਸਾਕਤ ਤੇ; ਕੋ. ਨ ਬਰਾਸਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
so no one gains anything from the faithless. ॥4॥
ਤਿਤ ਹੀ ਲਾਗਾ; ਜਿਤੁ ਕੋ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
One is attached to whatever He attaches one to.
Says Nanak, God has fashioned this arrangement. ॥5॥5॥
The One who created the soul, breath and body,
the One who created them, cares for them. ॥1॥
The Guru, the Lord of the universe, is the soul's helper,
ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ; ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸਦ ਛਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
whose shade is ever over us here and hereafter. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Worshipping God is the pure way of life.
In the company of the holy, perverse ways are destroyed. ॥2॥
Friends, well-wishers and wealth are no support.
know no other than the One. ॥4॥6॥
Ahead is the Merciful One, behind is the Lord;
in between, the Lord's love is the elixir. ॥1॥
God is my Shastra and my omen.
ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਭਉਣ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
In my home and dwelling there is peace, poise and bliss. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
With the Name on the tongue and heard with the ears, one lives.
ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ; ਸਿਮਰਿ; ਅਮਰ ਥਿਰੁ ਥੀਵੇ ॥੨॥
Remembering, remembering God, one becomes immortal and steady. ॥2॥
The pains of countless lifetimes are removed,
and the unstruck melody resounds in the court within. ॥3॥
Showing mercy, God has united them with Himself,
Nanak, those who have come to God's sanctuary. ॥4॥7॥
and it is a companion on the path of Death. ॥1॥
The Name of the Guru, the Lord of the universe, is the water of the Ganges.
ਜੋ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ; ਪੀਵਤ ਬਹੁੜਿ. ਨ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
One who remembers it is saved; drinking it, one does not wander in births again. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
remembering the Name, one becomes free of desire. ॥2॥
remembering the Name, one's conduct becomes perfect. ॥3॥
Servant Nanak has reached this conclusion:
ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ; ਮਿਥਿਆ ਸਭ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੮॥
without the Lord's Name, all is false, like dust. ॥4॥8॥
ਲੇਪੁ. ਨ ਲਾਗੋ; ਤਿਲ ਕਾ ਮੂਲਿ ॥
Not a speck of harm touched him at all;
ਦੁਸਟੁ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਮੂਆ; ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਸੂਲ ॥੧॥
the wicked Brahmin died of colic. ॥1॥
The transcendent Lord Himself has protected His servant.
The sinner died through the Guru's glory. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The servant meditates on his own Master;
the ignorant sinner was destroyed by the Lord Himself. ॥2॥
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ; ਅਪਣੇ ਦਾਸ ਕਾ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥
God, as Mother and Father, is the protector of His servant;
ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕਾ ਮਾਥਾ; ਈਹਾਂ ਊਹਾ ਕਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
the slanderer's face is blackened here and hereafter. ॥3॥
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ ਸੁਣੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
The transcendent Lord has heard servant Nanak's prayer;
the wicked sinner was consumed and died in despair. ॥4॥9॥
ਖੂਬੁ ਖੂਬੁ. ਖੂਬੁ ਖੂਬੁ; ਖੂਬੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Excellent, excellent, excellent, excellent, excellent is Your Name.
ਝੂਠੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਝੂਠੁ; ਝੂਠੁ ਦੁਨੀ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
False, false, false, false is pride in the world. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Beautiful are Your servants; their sight is infinitely precious.
1138: Without the Name, the whole world is dust. ॥1॥
ਅਚਰਜੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ; ਤੇਰੇ ਕਦਮ ਸਲਾਹ ॥
Wondrous is Your creation; Your feet are worthy of praise.
Your praise is priceless, O True King. ॥2॥
God is the support of the unsupported, their shelter;
He is kind to the poor; meditate on Him day and night. ॥3॥
The Master Himself is merciful to Nanak;
ਅਲਹੁ. ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ; ਦਿਲ ਜੀਅ ਪਰਾਨ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
may I never forget Allah, my heart, soul and breath. ॥4॥10॥
As Guru-facing, obtain the true wealth.
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ; ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਹਹੁ ॥੧॥
Accept God's will as true and bear it. ॥1॥
Rise each day and drink the Lord's elixir.
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ; ਰਸਨਾ ਕਹਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
With your tongue chant the Lord, Har Har Har Har. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
In this Dark Age, salvation is through the one Name.
Nanak speaks of the contemplation of God. ॥2॥11॥
Serving the True Guru, all fruits are obtained,
and the filth of countless lifetimes is erased. ॥1॥
Your Name, O God, is the purifier of sinners.
ਪੂਰਬਿ ਕਰਮ ਲਿਖੇ; ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Because of deeds written from the past, I sing Your praises. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
In the company of the holy one is saved,
and obtains glory at God's door. ॥2॥
All well-being lies in serving God's feet;
ਧੂਰਿ ਬਾਛਹਿ; ਸਭਿ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਦੇਵਾ ॥੩॥
all angelic beings and gods long for the dust of such a one. ॥3॥
Nanak has obtained the treasure of the Name;
ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ; ਉਧਰਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਜਹਾਨੁ ॥੪॥੧੨॥
meditating on the Lord, the whole world is saved. ॥4॥12॥
He hugs His servant close to His heart,
and casts the slanderer into the fire. ॥1॥
The Lord protects His own from the sinner.
ਪਾਪੀ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ. ਕਤਹੂ ਨਾਹੀ; ਪਾਪੀ ਪਚਿਆ ਆਪ ਕਮਾਇਣ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The sinner finds no salvation anywhere; the sinner is consumed by his own deeds. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The Lord's servant is in love with the dear Lord;
the slanderer is in love with evil. ॥2॥
The transcendent Lord has revealed His innate nature;
the evildoer has received the fruit of his own deeds. ॥3॥
He does not come or go; He is all-pervading.
Servant Nanak seeks the Lord's sanctuary. ॥4॥13॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਮੋਹਨ ਸਗਲ ਉਪਾਵਨ; ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
The enticing Lord of Lakshmi, Creator of all, formless Giver of peace —
ਐਸਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਛੋਡਿ. ਕਰਹਿ ਅਨ ਸੇਵਾ; ਕਵਨ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰਸ ਮਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
forsaking such a God, you serve another; what poisonous pleasures intoxicate you? ॥1॥
ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ; ਤੂ ਗੋਵਿਦ ਭਾਜੁ ॥
O my mind, meditate on the Lord of the universe.
ਅਵਰ ਉਪਾਵ ਸਗਲ ਮੈ ਦੇਖੇ; ਜੋ ਚਿਤਵੀਐ. ਤਿਤੁ ਬਿਗਰਸਿ ਕਾਜੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I have seen all other efforts; whatever one plans, that very task goes wrong. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਛੋਡਿ. ਦਾਸੀ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ; ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧ ਅਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
Forsaking the Master, the blind, ignorant self-willed dwell on His handmaiden, Maya.
ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ. ਤਿਨ ਨਿੰਦਹਿ; ਨਿਗੁਰੇ ਪਸੂ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
They slander those who worship the Lord; without a Guru they are like beasts. ॥2॥
ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ. ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ; ਸਾਕਤ ਕਹਤੇ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
Soul, body and wealth all belong to God, yet the faithless say, "mine."
1139: ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਹੈ ਮੈਲੀ; ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ. ਭਵਜਲਿ ਫੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
Their egotistic, evil intellect is filthy; without the Guru they cycle in the terrifying ocean. ॥3॥
ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸਭਿ ਸੰਜਮ; ਤਟਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ. ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Through burnt offerings, sacrificial feasts, chanting, penance, all disciplines, and bathing at riverbanks and pilgrimage places, He is not found.
ਮਿਟਿਆ ਆਪੁ. ਪਏ ਸਰਣਾਈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਗਤੁ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੪॥
Those who seek His sanctuary lose their ego; Nanak, through the Guru, the Lord carries the world across. ॥4॥1॥14॥
ਬਨ ਮਹਿ ਪੇਖਿਓ, ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਮਹਿ ਪੇਖਿਓ; ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਉਦਾਸਾਏ ॥
I have seen Him in the forest, in the grass, in the home and in the renunciate;
ਦੰਡਧਾਰ ਜਟਧਾਰੈ ਪੇਖਿਓ; ਵਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਤੀਰਥਾਏ ॥੧॥
I have seen Him in the staff-bearers and the matted-haired ones, in fasts, vows and pilgrimages. ॥1॥
In the company of the saints I have seen Him within my mind, O mother.
ਊਭ ਪਇਆਲ ਸਰਬ ਮਹਿ ਪੂਰਨ; ਰਸਿ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
He fills the skies, the nether regions and all; with delight I sing His joyous praises. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜੋਗ ਭੇਖ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੈ ਪੇਖਿਓ; ਜਤਿ ਜੰਗਮ ਕਾਪੜਾਏ ॥
I have seen Him in yogis, in religious garbs and sannyasis, in celibates, Jangams and ascetics in patched coats;
ਤਪੀ ਤਪੀਸੁਰ, ਮੁਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਪੇਖਿਓ; ਨਟ ਨਾਟਿਕ ਨਿਰਤਾਏ ॥੨॥
I have seen Him in penitents and great ascetics, in sages, in actors, plays and dances. ॥2॥
ਚਹੁ ਮਹਿ ਪੇਖਿਓ. ਖਟ ਮਹਿ ਪੇਖਿਓ; ਦਸ ਅਸਟੀ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਾਏ ॥
I have seen Him in the four Vedas, in the six Shastras, in the eighteen Puranas and the Smritis.
ਸਭ ਮਿਲਿ ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਵਖਾਨਹਿ; ਤਉ ਕਿਸ ਤੇ ਕਹਉ ਦੁਰਾਏ ॥੩॥
All together declare that He is the One; so from whom could I say He is hidden? ॥3॥
ਅਗਹ ਅਗਹ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਨਹ ਕੀਮ ਕੀਮ, ਕੀਮਾਏ ॥
The Master is unfathomable, unfathomable, infinite; His worth cannot be estimated.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ; ਜਿਹ ਘਟਿ ਪਰਗਟੀਆਏ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੫॥
Servant Nanak, let us be a sacrifice again and again to those in whose hearts He is revealed. ॥4॥2॥15॥
ਨਿਕਟਿ ਬੁਝੈ; ਸੋ ਬੁਰਾ. ਕਿਉ ਕਰੈ ॥
One who knows Him to be near — how can he do evil?
One who gathers poison wanders ever in fear.
ਹੈ ਨਿਕਟੇ; ਅਰੁ ਭੇਦੁ. ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
He is near, but one does not understand the mystery;
without the True Guru, all are enticed by Maya. ॥1॥
Everyone says He is near, near,
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭੇਦੁ; ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋ ਲਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
but rare is the Guru-facing one who grasps the mystery. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਨਿਕਟਿ. ਨ ਦੇਖੈ; ਪਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
One who does not see Him near goes into others' homes;
he steals their wealth and lives on falsehood.
ਪਈ ਠਗਉਰੀ; ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ. ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
Under the spell of the drug of Maya, he does not know the Lord is with him;
without the Guru he is misled by doubt. ॥2॥
One who does not know Him to be near speaks lies;
the fool is plundered by attachment to Maya.
The treasure is within, yet he goes searching in foreign lands;
without the Guru he is misled by doubt. ॥3॥
One on whose forehead grace is written,
serves the True Guru, and the shutters are opened.
Within and without, he sees that One close at hand.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ; ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੬॥
Servant Nanak, he does not come or go. ॥4॥3॥16॥
ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਹਿ; ਤਿਸੁ ਕਉਨੁ ਮਾਰੈ ॥
Whom You protect, who can kill?
ਸਭ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੈ ॥
All, the whole world, is within You.
The mortal thinks up millions of schemes,
ਸੋ ਹੋਵੈ; ਜਿ ਕਰੈ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
but that alone happens which the Lord of wondrous play does. ॥1॥
Save me, save me, show mercy;
I am in Your sanctuary, at Your court. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
One who serves the fearless Giver of peace
ਤਿਨਿ ਭਉ ਦੂਰਿ ਕੀਆ; ਏਕੁ ਪਰਾਤਾ ॥
has dispelled his fear and recognised the One.
ਜੋ ਤੂ ਕਰਹਿ; ਸੋਈ ਫੁਨਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Whatever You do, that alone happens;
no other can kill or protect. ॥2॥
What are you thinking, with your human nature?
The all-pervading Lord is the Inner-knower, all-wise.
The One is my anchor; the One is my support.
One upon whom the Creator casts His glance —
1140: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੇ; ਸਭਿ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
He resolves all the affairs of that servant.
That One alone is his protector;
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ; ਅਪੜਿ. ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੭॥
servant Nanak, no one can equal him. ॥4॥4॥17॥
We would grieve if He were outside us.
We would grieve if we forgot the Lord.
We would grieve if we loved another.
Why grieve, when He pervades everywhere? ॥1॥
In attachment to Maya one is consumed by grief upon grief;
ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ; ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਖਪਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
without the Name one wanders and wanders and wanders, and is ruined. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
We would grieve if there were another Creator.
ਤਉ ਕੜੀਐ; ਜੇ ਅਨਿਆਇ ਕੋ ਮਰਤਾ ॥
We would grieve if anyone died unjustly.
ਤਉ ਕੜੀਐ; ਜੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
We would grieve if He did not know everything.
Why grieve, when You fully pervade all? ॥2॥
ਤਉ ਕੜੀਐ; ਜੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਇ ਧਿਙਾਣੈ ॥
We would grieve if anything happened by force.
We would grieve if He caused suffering by mistake.
ਗੁਰਿ ਕਹਿਆ; ਜੋ ਹੋਇ ਸਭੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇ ॥
The Guru has said that whatever happens is all from God.
ਤਬ ਕਾੜਾ ਛੋਡਿ; ਅਚਿੰਤ ਹਮ ਸੋਤੇ ॥੩॥
So I have abandoned grief, and I sleep without anxiety. ॥3॥
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੂਹੈ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ; ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
O God, You alone are the Master; all are Yours.
As it pleases You, so You decide.
There is no other; the One pervades all.
Preserve Nanak's honour; he is in Your sanctuary. ॥4॥5॥18॥
Without music, how can there be dancing?
Without a voice, how can a singer sing?
Without strings, how can the rebab be played?
Without the Name, all affairs are useless. ॥1॥
Tell me, who has crossed over without the Name?
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ; ਕੈਸੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Without the True Guru, how can one get across? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Without a tongue, how can anyone speak?
Without ears, how can anyone hear?
Without eyes, how can anyone see?
ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਰੁ; ਕਹੀ. ਨ ਲੇਖੈ ॥੨॥
Without the Name, a man counts for nothing. ॥2॥
Without learning, how can anyone be a pandit?
Without authority, what is the splendour of a king?
Without understanding, how can the mind be steadied?
Without the Name, the whole world is insane. ॥3॥
Without detachment, how can one be a renunciate?
ਬਿਨੁ ਹਉ ਤਿਆਗਿ; ਕਹਾ ਕੋਊ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥
Without renouncing ego, how can anyone be detached?
ਬਿਨੁ ਬਸਿ ਪੰਚ; ਕਹਾ ਮਨ ਚੂਰੇ ॥
Without subduing the five, how can the mind be crushed?
ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ; ਸਦ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਝੂਰੇ ॥੪॥
Without the Name, one grieves forever and ever. ॥4॥
Without the Guru's teaching, how can there be wisdom?
Without seeing, tell me, how can there be meditation?
Without the fear of God, all talk is corruption.
Says Nanak, this is the wisdom of the Lord's door. ॥5॥6॥19॥
Man is afflicted with the disease of ego;

only my True Guru, the true Yogi, is free of disease. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Through the disease of taste, the fish is caught;
through the disease of scent, the bumblebee is destroyed;
the whole world is caught in the disease of attachment;
in the disease of the three qualities, vices multiply. ॥2॥
In disease one dies, in disease one is born;
in disease one wanders again and again through wombs.
